# ul-indent

- ID: `MD007`
- Category: Lists
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `bullet`, `ul`, `indentation`

Outside ordered lists, bullets sit at the margin and indent 2 spaces per level.

## Why

Two spaces line up a nested bullet with the text of the bullet above it.

## Options

Set them under `rules.ul-indent.options`.

- `indent` (`integer`, default `2`): Spaces of indentation for each level of a
  nested list.
- `start_indented` (`boolean`, default `false`): Indent the first level of a
  list too.
- `start_indent` (`integer`, defaults to the value of `indent`): Spaces of
  indentation for the first level when start\_indented is set.

## Fix

The fix re-indents the bullet. gomdlint reports some items without a fix, such
as one that holds a second paragraph, a code block or a quote. gomdlint may
report a finding without a fix when the fix would change a line with one
character in brackets, such as \[x\] or \[1\], or the lines around it up to a
blank line, because it could add or remove a task list checkbox. In a document
with raw HTML other than comments and plain br, wbr, hr or img tags, gomdlint
reports every finding without a fix.

## Configure

```yaml
rules:
  ul-indent:
    options:
      indent: 2
```

Under `rules`, `ul-indent: false` turns the rule off and `ul-indent: error`
reports its findings as errors. The flag `--disable ul-indent` turns it off for
one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line ul-indent -->
```
